setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Beautifully rendered Dark Star, though the beginning is cut off [10][11][12][13]
- **The Eleven** (4 reviews): Short jam near the beginning is described as dynamite [10][11][12][13]
- **New Potato Caboose** (2 reviews): New Potato Caboose into Drums and Jam is a top 1968 jam; The only knock is the abrupt end of New Potato Caboose [15][17]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Second round of Cryptical Envelopment becomes intensely powerful [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.86761.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 75 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.115606.flac16**: soundboard; 9 songs; 73 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [5]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.owen.7772.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 75 min; rated 4.88/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.gans.miller.owen.9386.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 75 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer states this is a better show than the previous night [10]
- Reviewer states this is a better show than the previous night [11]
- Reviewer states this is a better show than the previous night [12]
- Reviewer states this is a better show than the previous night [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.86761.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [1]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.115606.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [5]. Also: Beginning of Dark Star is missing from the recording; Reel flips occur in The Eleven and New Potato Caboose; Joe B. Jones helped with the pitch correction [5]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.miller.owen.7772.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Michael Owen; source: MR>DAT>CD [2]
- **gd1968-10-13.sbd.gans.miller.owen.9386.shnf**: transferred by David Gans; source: MSR > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CD [3]
